remarks: Fully renovated, spacious 4 Bedroom, 2.5 Bath home with idyllic water views. Enjoy this serene and bucolic environment while only minutes from both New Canaan and Darien amenities, shopping, I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. Completely updated kitchen, bath rooms, appliances and mechanicals. Fireplaces in both living and family rooms. Loft/Office and massive attic bonus room/storage area. You will not find a more pristine, well cared for house and property. Landlord responsible for all exterior maintenance so you can just relax and enjoy nature and the exquisite surroundings. Pond views from most rooms. Don't miss this unique setting. Minimum 12 Month lease, but owner would prefer 15 or 18 Month Term.
